photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 12:22:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 343 s; on-screen clock 05/16/13 12:22:50, wanted 12:22:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-135  msg 12:22' on 2013-05-15 (`as run matrix!B118`), read as 2013-05-15 12:22. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-05-15 plus one day, 12:22: it was found 293 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (52) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('52', `as run matrix!J118`).
